project_title: Mentoria em Grupo - Dra. Lígia Jeane Matroski
design_archetype: Awwwards Editorial & Organic Warmth (Serif Italic + Earthy Layered Palette)
context_type: Marketing / Sales Landing Page (Human, Feminine, High-Impact Editorial)

typography.body_font_family: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light italic leading-[1.1]
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-light italic leading-[1.2]

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: cards 16px to 24px (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl), buttons pill (rounded-full)
layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: generous spacing (py-16, py-24, py-32 for desktop sections; px-6 or px-8 internal card padding)

components_and_sections.name: Navbar
components_and_sections.instructions: Transitions from transparent over Hero to solid backdrop-blur-md (#3A2E27/90 or #F2EAE0/95) on scroll. Features brand logo/monogram, smooth anchor links (#sobre, #pilares, #detalhes, #investimento, #faq), remaining spots indicator badge, and 'Garantir Minha Vaga' pill button.

components_and_sections.name: Hero Section
components_and_sections.instructions: Fullscreen editorial presentation with full-bleed warm therapeutic interior background photo (without face). Subtle dark gradient overlay (bg-black/40 via-black/20). Masked line-by-line reveal text animation. Big italic display serif headline: 'Um espaço seguro para transformar incertezas em clareza com a Dra. Lígia Jeane'. Subheadline, event date badge (10/10/2026 - 50 vagas), and creme pill CTA button with smooth scroll or modal trigger.

components_and_sections.name: Marquee
components_and_sections.instructions: Slow, elegant editorial drift ribbon with low-contrast warm text and serif italic key phrases separated by subtle dots or icons.

components_and_sections.name: Emotional Block
components_and_sections.instructions: High-impact emotional section centered around 'Talvez você não precise de mais respostas.' Generous negative space, warm background texture, intimate tone of voice.

components_and_sections.name: For You (6 Cards)
components_and_sections.instructions: 6 generous rounded cards (16-24px radius) titled 'Essa experiência é para você que...'. Deep chocolate or warm caramel border highlights, subtle hover lift, data-testid attributes for each item.

components_and_sections.name: 3 Pillars
components_and_sections.instructions: Three prominent pillars: 01 Consciência, 02 Reflexão, 03 Novas possibilidades. Numbered with large soft gold italic numerals (01, 02, 03) and editorial description blocks.

components_and_sections.name: Dark Section with Mockup & Services
components_and_sections.instructions: Rich dark chocolate (#3A2E27) background section. 16:9 aspect ratio video container with custom 'DAR PLAY' trigger button, accompanied by laptop/tablet mockup visual and pill buttons list for mentorship features and deliverables.

components_and_sections.name: Sobre a Lígia
components_and_sections.instructions: Caramel/taupe (#A98E72) background section. Professional photo inside a realistic Phone Frame mockup (Moldura de Celular). Displays Monogram LJ placeholder gracefully if official photo is not uploaded in admin. Bio highlight: 20+ years of clinical psychology & mentorship experience, approach, and credentials.

components_and_sections.name: Impact Quote
components_and_sections.instructions: A bold, reflective sentence in large Cormorant Garamond italic serif with warm background accent.

components_and_sections.name: Event Details & Real-Time Seats
components_and_sections.instructions: Clear event schedule details (10/10/2026, Online ao Vivo, Grupo Fechado). Real-time seats counter with 3 states: 'Restam X vagas', 'Última vaga disponível', 'Inscrições encerradas'.

components_and_sections.name: Offer & Pricing
components_and_sections.instructions: Transparent pricing cards comparing Pix (R$ 189,90) vs Cartão (R$ 229,00 em até 3x). Highlights benefits, immediate checkout access via InfinitePay, and 3 purchase steps.

components_and_sections.name: FAQ Accordion
components_and_sections.instructions: Shadcn accordion styled with custom warm borders and readable contrast. Covers event mechanics, recording access, refund policy, and privacy.

components_and_sections.name: Final CTA & Fixed Mobile CTA
components_and_sections.instructions: Compelling wrap-up CTA banner. Includes sticky mobile bottom bar with seat counter and quick registration CTA.

components_and_sections.name: Footer
components_and_sections.instructions: Dark chocolate background with logo, CRP credentials, terms & privacy modals, copyright 2026.

motion_and_effects.text_reveal: Framer motion line-by-line reveal with subtle vertical motion and opacity stagger
motion_and_effects.hover_states: Soft scale-102 transition and shadow-lg on cards, pill button light shimmer

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, accordion triggers, CTA buttons, seat counter badges, price cards) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='seats-counter-badge', data-testid='checkout-pix-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 14 functional sections are retained while applying the Awwwards editorial redesign. Preserve state logic, checkout router flows, backend API endpoints, seat counter logic, and admin setting color pickers. Do not invent testimonials or false data. Maintain mobile-first responsive design with fixed CTA.
